title: Swimming Pools at Shanty Creek
html:
Whether you're cooling off in summer or relaxing after a day on the slopes, Shanty Creek offers multiple pools across its villages for guests to enjoy.

• The Lakeview Hotel (Summit Village) – Features both indoor and outdoor pools, perfect for year-round fun.
• Schuss Village – Offers a heated indoor pool, ideal for post-ski relaxation or rainy-day swims.
• Cedar River Village – Home to a seasonal outdoor pool and two outdoor hot tubs, making it a great spot to unwind with a view.

Your pool pass covers the Lakeview Hotel indoor and outdoor pools only. The other village pools are not included with your stay.

From splashing around with kids to soaking in a hot tub under the stars, each village provides a unique poolside experience.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Children’s Play Area – Summit Village
html:
Fun for the little ones (and a peaceful break for you!)
Located near The Lakeview Hotel and Summit Fitness Center, the Summit Village children’s playground offers a welcome spot for kids to let off energy while parents relax.

What to Expect:

  • Nature-inspired play equipment including slides, climbing structures, and open space
  • Shaded areas perfect for little explorers
  • Close to amenities like restrooms, dining, and the fitness center
  • Ideal for combined family time—kids can play while you plan your next adventure

This playground is especially handy when visiting the Lodge or staying in Summit Village lodging.

title: Tennis at Summit Village
html:
Serve up summer fun with a game of tennis at Shanty Creek! Located in Summit Village, the tennis courts offer scenic views overlooking the golf course—making each match both competitive and picturesque.

Racquets and tennis balls are available for use from the Summit Fitness Center, so you can hit the court without packing gear.

Whether you're a seasoned player or just looking for a friendly rally, the courts at Shanty Creek are a great way to stay active and soak up the northern Michigan sunshine.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Disc Golf at Summit Mountain
html:
Get outside and enjoy a fun, casual round of disc golf on Shanty Creek’s 9-hole disc golf course, set along the scenic slopes of Summit Mountain, just behind The Lakeview Hotel.

Perfect for families, beginners, or seasoned disc golfers looking for a relaxed round with a view. It’s a great way to enjoy the outdoors while getting in some light activity.

Discs, scorecards, and course maps are available at the Summit Fitness Center.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Go Outside and Play
html:
Unplug, unwind, and get active with a variety of outdoor games around the resort. Whether you’re looking for a friendly match or a spontaneous showdown, there’s something for everyone.

Try your hand at:
• A quick game of H-O-R-S-E on the basketball court
• Sand volleyball under the summer sun
• A match of badminton or shuffleboard
• Laid-back fun with bocce ball, tetherball, or wiffle ball
• Or hit the tennis courts for something more competitive

Most equipment is available on-site—just show up and play!

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Lawn Games
html:
Let’s Play! Summer days at Shanty Creek are perfect for some classic fun on the lawn.

Challenge friends and family with traditional favorites and supersized fun:

• Horseshoes
• Croquet
• Bean Bag Toss
• Ladder Ball
• Washer Toss
• Giant Checkers
• Giant Jenga
• Giant Dominos
• Lawn Yahtzee

For game info and equipment, stop by the Summit Fitness Center in Summit Village. Let the games begin!

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Boating
html:
There’s nothing like being on the water—and Antrim County’s Chain of Lakes delivers it all.

Whether you're:
• Splashing on the sandbar with friends
• Water skiing or wakeboarding
• Kayaking or paddling down peaceful rivers
• Fishing for bass and walleye

This 75-mile waterway system connects lakes and rivers perfect for boating adventures, relaxation, and fun in the sun.

Bring your own boat or rent locally—just get out there and enjoy northern Michigan’s freshwater paradise!

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Biking
html:
Antrim County is a cyclist’s dream—whether you prefer the road or rugged trails.

• Road Biking: Ride the quiet, rolling hills and scenic byways with minimal traffic and stunning views.
• Mountain Biking: Explore Glacial Hills, one of Michigan’s premier trail systems with loops for all skill levels.
• E-Bike Rentals: New to biking or want help with hills? Rent a motor-assisted e-bike from the Summit Fitness Center.
• Traditional Bikes also available for cruising around the resort.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Hiking
html:
Looking for a scenic workout? Shanty Creek offers hiking experiences for every pace and preference:

• Schuss Mountain Trails – Tackle a summertime climb for a rewarding hike with panoramic views of northern Michigan.
• Grass River Natural Area – Just a short drive away, this network of trails winds through forests, wetlands, and along the water’s edge—perfect for peaceful nature walks and wildlife spotting.

Whether you're in it for fitness or fresh air, these trails highlight the natural beauty of the region.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: After Dark | Outdoor Movies + Stargazing
html:
When the sun goes down, the fun doesn’t stop at Shanty Creek.

Outdoor Movies on the Mountain
Select Saturday nights, Summit Mountain transforms into a cozy outdoor theater featuring family-friendly films under the stars. Bring a blanket, a chair, and settle in for a movie night with breathtaking views.

Stargazing in Northern Michigan
Clear skies bring out a whole new show—the stars. Far from city lights, Shanty Creek is a great place to spot constellations, shooting stars, and if you're lucky, the Northern Lights. Stargazing here is a must-do northern Michigan experience.

Tip: Dress warm and bring a thermos. Even summer nights can get cool at the top.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Schuss Mountain Trail Map
html:
Welcome to one of Michigan’s top ski destinations—where terrain, trails, and fun come together at Schuss Mountain, Shanty Creek Resort.

Trail Overview | Schuss Mountain offers a variety of trails for all skill levels. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, you’ll find groomed runs, glades, terrain parks, and great views across the mountain.

Trail Difficulty | Symbol | Description
Easiest | ● Green Circle | Wide, gentle slopes perfect for beginners
Intermediate | ♦ Blue Square | More challenging runs for developing skiers
Difficult | ◆ Black Diamond | Steeper, narrower, and faster terrain
Most Difficult | ⯁ Double Black Diamond | Expert terrain with steep drops and glades

Lifts - Schuss Mountain is equipped with a variety of lifts to help you access all areas of the resort efficiently:

  • Purple Lift – Access to beginner/intermediate terrain
  • Red Lift – Access to terrain park and advanced runs
  • Yellow Lift – Connects to summit trails
  • Surface Lifts – Perfect for beginners and ski school zones

Terrain Parks - Test your skills or try something new:

  • Low Rider Terrain Park – Features jumps, rails, and boxes for freestyle riders

  • Progression Zones – Great for learning tricks safely

Key Areas

  • Schuss Village – Base area with day lodge, rentals, tickets, ski school, and food
  • The Pink Lift Corner – Connects with multiple trail zones for diverse runs
  • Cedar River Village – Offers ski-in/ski-out access and lodging
  • Ski Patrol – Located near key intersections for safety and assistance

Tips for Visitors

  • Start your day early for fresh corduroy runs
  • Green trails near the base are best for families and beginners
  • Use lift maps and signage to plan your route across the mountain
  • Helmets are recommended for all riders

Download full trail map: Schuss Mountain Trail Map PDF

title: Nordic Trail Map
html:
Explore the snow-covered beauty of Shanty Creek Resort through its scenic Nordic ski and snowshoe trails. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced skier, these trails offer a peaceful and invigorating way to enjoy winter across Schuss Mountain.

Trail Overview
Trail Name | Distance (km) | Difficulty | Trail Use
Mountain Creek | 2.5 km | ● Moderate | Cross-country skiing
Poets Loop | 4.5 km | ● Moderate | Cross-country skiing
Pine Cone | 4.5 km | ◆ Difficult | Cross-country skiing
Winter Brook | 1.5 km | ● Moderate | Cross-country skiing
King of the Hill | 1.5 km | ◆ Difficult | Cross-country skiing
Schuss Mountain | 3.0 km | ● Easiest | Multi-purpose (snowshoe & bike)

Trail Markings
  • ⬤ Easiest
  • ● Moderate
  • ◆ Difficult
  • ⬛ Trail Head
  • Aa Landmarks

Each trail is clearly marked with signage and trailhead icons for convenience.

Village-to-Village Adventure

Many of these trails connect Schuss Mountain Village to surrounding areas like Cedar River Village, providing a “village-to-village” Nordic experience. You’ll pass iconic spots like Riverview, Red Lift Corner, and #3 Tee, making your trek both scenic and exciting.

Hours of Operation

  • Mon, Thurs, Fri: 9am – 4pm
  • Sat–Sun: 9am – 5pm
  • Closed: Tues & Wed
  • Holiday hours may vary

Ready to explore the trails?
View the full trail map here: https://www.shantycreek.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Nordic-Trail-Map-2025.jpg

More info: shantycreek.com/ski/nordic-trails

title: Skiing & Snowboarding
html:
Shanty Creek Resort offers one of Michigan’s most beloved ski destinations with over 50 downhill slopes spread across Schuss Mountain and Summit Mountain, making it ideal for skiers and snowboarders of all skill levels.

Whether you’re a beginner looking for gentle runs or a seasoned skier chasing fresh powder and steeps, the variety of terrain, well-maintained conditions, and laid-back vibe deliver exactly what you need.

With breathtaking northern Michigan scenery and a full-service resort experience, Schuss Mountain simply delivers A Better Value.

For more info: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/

title: Nordic Skiing
html:
Few activities capture the quiet beauty of northern Michigan in winter quite like Nordic skiing. At Shanty Creek Resort, you’ll find 18km of groomed, track-set cross-country trails that wind between the resort’s four villages—creating a scenic, heart-healthy, and soul-refreshing village-to-village skiing experience.

Whether you're looking for a cardio workout or a serene glide through the snow-covered woods, these trails deliver.

🔹 Multi-Purpose Trail:
If Nordic skiing isn’t your thing, a 3km groomed trail in Schuss Village is open for fat tire biking and snowshoeing, keeping trail usage safe and enjoyable for all guests.

🔹 Nordic Center at Schuss Village:
Located adjacent to the Pine Cone trailhead, the Nordic Center offers:

  • Classic & skating-style ski rentals

  • Snowshoe rentals

  • Friendly assistance to get you trail-ready

🔹 Hours of Operation:

  • Thursday–Friday: 9AM – 4PM

  • Saturday–Sunday: 9AM – 5PM

  • Monday: 9AM – 4PM

  • Closed Tuesdays & Wednesdays

  • Extended hours during holidays

🔹 Lessons Available:

  • Advance booking (48 hrs) is recommended

  • Cancellations require 48 hrs’ notice for a refund

  • Instructor requests must be made at least 3 days in advance

Explore over 20km of tranquil, groomed Nordic trails, perfect for beginners and experienced skiers alike.

For more info: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/nordic-trails/

title: Alpine Tubing
html:
If skiing and snowboarding aren’t your thing—don’t worry! There’s still a fast and fun way to enjoy the snow. Alpine Tubing at Summit Mountain is a must-try winter activity, delivering all the thrills of sledding without the uphill climb.

You’ll hear laughter echoing across the slopes as guests of all ages race down the tubing lanes and ride the surface lift right back to the top. No skills required—just hold on and enjoy the ride!

🎯 What to Know:

  • Available Friday evenings, Saturdays, Sundays & holidays

  • Sessions start at the top of every hour

  • $25/hour on weekends and holidays, $23/hour on non-weekend days

  • Online booking only

  • Participants must be 36″ tall

💡 Parents Note:
The last two hours on Friday and Saturday nights are recommended for Adults Only—ideal for grown-ups looking to enjoy some child-free fun.

Whether you're with friends, family, or flying solo, Alpine Tubing offers a unique and laughter-filled way to enjoy Shanty Creek’s winter wonderland.

More info & booking: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/more-on-the-snow/#tubing

title: Fat Tire Biking
html:
Ride On—Even in the Snow

Experience winter like never before with fat tire biking on our 3km multi-purpose trail at Schuss Village. Whether you're an experienced rider or just looking to try something new, this packed trail offers a smooth and scenic ride through snow-covered landscapes. It’s also shared with snowshoers and walkers—yes, even leashed pups are welcome!

Don’t have your own bike? No problem. Fat tire bike rentals are available through Paddles & Pedals in downtown Bellaire. Call them at 231-533-4449 to reserve your ride.

For more details, visit: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/more-on-the-snow/

title: Snow Glide Tours
html:
Experience winter like never before with Shanty Creek’s Snow Glide Tours — a scenic, cozy, and memorable ride for all ages.

Departing from The Lakeview Hotel's front circle, this 45-minute guided tour winds through the snow-blanketed landscapes of Summit Village, offering sweeping views and a peaceful winter retreat without breaking a sweat. Whether you're snapping photos or simply soaking in the scenery, it’s the perfect way to appreciate the magic of northern Michigan in winter.

Each tour accommodates up to 9 passengers and is safely pulled behind “Big Blue,” a powerful double-track snowmobile. The Snow Glide is equipped with seatbelts for a secure and comfortable ride.

Tour Schedule:

  • Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and select holiday dates

  • Departures on the hour from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM

Price: $25 per seat
Limited availability – early booking is highly recommended!

More Info & Booking: https://www.shantycreek.com/snow-glide-tours/

title: Snowshoeing
html:
Forge Your Own Trail – Adventure Awaits

Whether you're a seasoned snowshoer or trying it for the first time, snowshoeing at Shanty Creek offers a peaceful and scenic way to explore the winter woods of northern Michigan.

Slip on a pair and start walking—no special skills required. You can blaze your own path through the snowy landscape or follow the groomed 3km multi-purpose trail located at Schuss Village, shared with fat tire bikers and designed to minimize trail damage while keeping everyone safe.

Rental Equipment is available at the Nordic Center in Schuss Village, including snowshoes and poles.

This is a perfect winter activity for those seeking quiet beauty, fresh air, and an easy-going workout.

More Info: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/more-on-the-snow/

title: Cedar River
html:
“...a pleasure to play and a beauty to experience.” Cedar River’s glacial-carved canvas was perfect for famed course architect Tom Weiskopf to design this masterpiece.

Among "America’s Top 100 Resort Courses" in Golf Week and the “Top 1,000 Courses in the World” by Rolex. Along with The Legend, Cedar River is listed among Michigan’s Top 20 Public Courses according to Golf Magazine.

Cedar River Score Card

Cedar River Tee Times

Closed Mondays and Tuesdays

title: Foot & Disc Golf
html:
Mix the skills of soccer or disc golf with the scoring of golf, and you get a fun new way to bring the whole family to the links. Shanty Creek has an exclusive 9-hole Foot & Disc Golf course with hybrid basket cups. The goal, like golf, is the fewest shots from tee to hole.

Ready to play? $12 includes a ball or disc. To make a tee time, call 231-533-2020.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/golf/golf-2-0/#footgolf

title: Hawk's Eye
html:
“...the perfect complement to Cedar River and The Legend.”

Adding to Shanty Creek's golf reputation, this John Robinson design features incredible vistas, water hazards on 9 of 18 holes, and putting greens to challenge golfers of all levels. Named among "Michigan's Top Courses" from Golf Advisor and the “Top 25 Course Layouts in the US."

Hawk's Eye Scorecard

Hawk's Eye Tee Times

Closed Mondays and Tuesdays

title: Schuss Mountain
html:
Schuss Mtn delivers a challenge for even the most accomplished golfers. Par eludes many throughout 7,013 yards of pine-dotted forests, wetlands, and rolling hills.

Playing like two distinct 9-hole courses, the front doglegs through pine forests on a flat pitch. Then on the back, play jumps up and down the rolling hills of Antrim County delivering an overall exciting golf experience made only better by our crew's tremendous care to its course conditions.

Schuss Mountain Scorecard

Schuss Mountain Tee Times

Closed Mondays and Tuesdays

title: Summit
html:
...an under-appreciated gem.” While length is not a factor, Summit forces accomplished golfers to test their short game. Precise landings and fast, challenging greens will make you earn your score.

A Par Three tee box on every hole gives junior golfers a fun (and less intimidating!) way to develop their game.

Summit Scorecard

Summit Tee Times

Closed Wednesdays and Thursdays

title: The Legend
html:
by Arnold Palmer

The Legend's reputation has been built on multiple elevation changes, doglegs, water hazards, and well-placed traps. Its setting includes views of Lake Bellaire and the actual Shanty Creek trickles through your round.

Arnold Palmer helped introduce northern Michigan golf to the world when Golf Magazine named it among the “Top Resort Courses” in the US. 4½ stars from Golf Digest.

The Legend Scorecard

The Legend Tee Times

Closed Wednesdays and Thursdays

title: Beach Club – Lake Bellaire (Private Access)
html:
Designed exclusively for resort guests, Shanty Creek’s private Beach Club sits on the shores of beautiful Lake Bellaire, offering around 200 feet of sandy shoreline and a serene swim area that’s ideal for families and couples alike.

What You’ll Find
  • Sandy beach & loungers for sunbathing and relaxation
  • Designated swim zone for safe, shallow water play
  • Kayak and paddleboard rentals available nearby
  • Easy access to restrooms and picnic facilities, plus grill areas
  • Perfect proximity to nearby resort amenities—dining, tennis, fitness & entertainment are all just a short walk away
Location
  • Situated on Lake Bellaire, just a few minutes from Summit Village
  • Close to dining and shopping options, including Short’s Brewing in downtown Bellaire (~3 minutes away)
Why You’ll Love It
  • A private, peaceful escape with crystal-clear waters and shimmering lake views
  • Buffer from crowds → relaxing space for unwinding
  • Splendid sunsets and water views — perfect for low-key evenings

Access: Only available to registered Shanty Creek lodging guests.
More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/

title: The Lakeview Hotel
html:
Enjoy the heart of Summit Village at the charming Lakeview Hotel, nestled above Lake Bellaire. With lakeside views, easy access to trails, golf, and top-tier amenities, it’s the ideal upscale base for your northern Michigan adventure.

Amenities & Features
  • 180 stylish rooms with balconies, flat-screen TVs, mini-fridges, and microwaves
  • Full-service restaurant & lounge on-site, plus the CoffeeBAR serving Starbucks beverages and light fare daily
  • Adjacent to two outdoor tennis courts and a basketball court
Pool & Fitness Access
  • Indoor pool: Open daily 9 AM–11 PM
  • Outdoor pool: Open 10 AM–10 PM
  • Free access to modern fitness center, sauna, steam room, and whirlpool (guests aged 14+)
Activities & Nearby Recreation
  • Walk to The Legend golf course (#10 & #11 tees), and enjoy quick access to Hawk’s Eye and Torch Lake (6–15 min drive)
  • Free ski shuttle to downhill and cross-country trails; ski-in/ski-out access available via shuttles and lifts
  • Boating, biking, hiking, and summer rentals nearby—plus golf packages and golf-centric lodging options
Guest Services & Perks
  • Complimentary shuttle service across all resort villages and downtown Bellaire, plus local grocery runs
  • 24/7 front desk, daily housekeeping, and nightly resort security included for lodging guests
  • Access to resort-area shopping, gift cards, and concierge services via the Guest Service team
Size & Location Snapshot
  • Address: 5780 Shanty Creek Road, Bellaire, MI 49615
  • Distance: 0.2 mi from The Legend GC; 3 mi to Lake Bellaire; ~6 mi to Short’s Brewery
  • Check-In: 5:00 PM | Check-Out: 12:00 PM
  • Parking: Free self-parking, with ADA-accessible spaces
Why Stay at Lakeview
  • Lakeside views, modern amenities, and easy access to Summit Village attractions
  • Multiple pool options and a full gym for fitness or relaxation
  • Central hub for golf, skiing, alpine tubing, biking, and nightlife
  • Upscale comfort with resort-style service and convenience

More Info & Reservations:
Explore The Lakeview Hotel → https://www.shantycreek.com/venue/lakeview-hotel
